answer: An operator that abandons 204 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the orchard forfeiture shows up in the vault totals with the prism audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 22% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
